theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_l1_boundary_variation_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid (d + 1))) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn U (d + 1)) (u : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (ε : Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d) (f : Euclid (d + 1) → ℝ) (z : Euclid (d + 1)) (M : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (d + 1), Y ω = ∫ y in U, u y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (d + 1)) (d + 1)) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) → Y.boundary.massOn U ≠ ∞ → covectorEuclideanNorm ε ≤ ‖z‖ → (∀ y, exteriorDerivative (fun x => f x • ε) y (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = fderiv ℝ f y z) → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → tsupport f ⊆ U → (∀ y, |f y| ≤ M) → |∫ y in U, u y * fderiv ℝ f y z| ≤ (Y.boundary.massOn U).toReal * ‖z‖ * M
